# Questions for our advisers

Prepared 6 Nov 2026. These three packs collect, in one place, every question the order system is waiting on from people outside the company. Send each pack to the right person. When the answers come back, the settings, SOPs and go-live checklist are updated in one small change.

| Pack | For | What it settles |
|---|---|---|
| [CA_questions.md](CA_questions.md) | Chartered Accountant | Associate commission abroad (GST, TDS, 15CA/15CB), TDS settings, Domestic Trade GST, import duty, Zoho account names |
| [AD_bank_questions.md](AD_bank_questions.md) | Our AD (authorised dealer) bank | Merchant Trade rules and approval, the LC bank for imports, FIRC/eBRC |
| [Lawyer_questions.md](Lawyer_questions.md) | Company lawyer | Associate agreement, Sales Manager Schedule A, the new non-stone T&C clauses, associate access levels |

**What is needed before the Export go-live:** CA questions 1–6 (associates and TDS) and Lawyer questions 1–3 (agreements). Everything else is needed only before the matching division is switched on in Admin › Divisions.

Every value quoted under "Today" is the starting value in `docs/seed.sql` as of 6 Nov 2026. Each one is an editable setting; nothing has been confirmed by an adviser yet.
